title: Practice 10: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: А уж как ___ (бежать — to run, one way)!
exercises.why: **бежали** — past tense (plural) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (ползти — to crawl, one way) ко мне.
exercises.why: **ползите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of ползти: one-direction verb (many directions: ползать).

exercises.q: ___ (катить — to roll, one way) за мной!
exercises.why: **кати** — imperative (ты, singular) of катить: one-direction verb (many directions: катать).

exercises.q: Чего они ___ (лезть — to climb, one way)?
exercises.why: **лезут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Кому это ___ (лезть — to climb, one way)?
exercises.why: **лезть** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way) без голов.
exercises.why: **бегут** — future tense (3rd person plural) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Ну, ___ (лезть — to climb, one way) сюда!
exercises.why: **полезай** — imperative (ты, singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: За ворот ___ (тащить — to drag, one way)!
exercises.why: **тащи** — imperative (ты, singular) of тащить: one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).

exercises.q: Эй, ___ (лезть — to climb, one way) сюда!
exercises.why: **лезь** — imperative (ты, singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Надо вон ___ (тащить — to drag, one way)!
exercises.why: **тащить** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).

exercises.q: ___ (лезть — to climb, one way) на полку.
exercises.why: **лезут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Куда мне ___ (катить — to roll, one way)?
exercises.why: **катить** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: катать).

exercises.q: Кто это ___ (лезть — to climb, one way)?.
exercises.why: **лезет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Куда, куда ___ (бежать — to run, one way)?
exercises.why: **бежите** — future tense (2nd person plural) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Сени надо ___ (тащить — to drag, one way)!
exercises.why: **тащить** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).

exercises.q: В дворяне ___ (лезть — to climb, one way)?
exercises.why: **лезете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Орлов, ___ (тащить — to drag, one way) его.
exercises.why: **тащите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of тащить: one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).

exercises.q: И сырость ___ (ползти — to crawl, one way).
exercises.why: **ползёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ползти: one-direction verb (many directions: ползать).

exercises.q: Ну, Павлин ___ (лезть — to climb, one way).
exercises.why: **лезет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Право, кот ___ (лезть — to climb, one way).
exercises.why: **лез** — past tense (masculine) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).
